cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella; I'll tell you where.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The stick's too sharp. We need a broad contact, not a puncture. Turn your umbrella round and use the handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe, but finding a surface won't prove it can hold us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once you find it, slide your picnic basket onto it. Keep hold of the handle, please. We're testing a load, not donating lunch.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects contact shape and A5 load handling, making sole-expert test management obtain B's first practical action toward the invisible bridge.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 stick proposal causes A3 umbrella-handle distinction; B4 surface-versus-load objection causes A5 conditional basket test.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to use A's equipment and B4 gives a meaningful limit on the proof, a cautious partner rather than a prop.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 load concern and explicitly waits for a found surface before requesting the weighted trial.

specificity.evidence: A1 ditch and bridge claim establish task; A3 no longer puts the surface beyond hand reach.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 lunch remark motivates keeping hold of the basket; it belongs to the specific test rather than an unrelated gag.

coach2.stated: A1 invisible bridge over ditch; B2 walking stick available; A3 stick sharp; B4 probing agreed, not yet done.
coach2.inferred: A may be overconfident about tools; neither bridge existence nor basket load proves human safety.
coach2.missing: No essential spatial assumption remains; first contact precedes loading explicitly.
coach2.firstDefect: Earlier reach and premature-surface weaknesses repaired.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 rejects B2 sharp stick and directs broad-handle use.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 accepts probing but questions load proof.
